requirements.general_text: Any of These: Sijil Pelajaran Malaysia (SPM): Pass with a minimum of 5 credits in the following subjects: Science Mathematics 3 other subjects; AND Passed English and Bahasa Malaysia. International General Certificate of Secondary Education (IGCSE) / Certificate: Minimum of Grade B in 3 subjects: Mathematics Science Any other subjects International General Certificate of Secondary Education (IGCSE) – O Levels: Pass with a minimum of Grade C in 5 subjects: Science Mathematics; AND 3 other subjects Any other equivalent qualification recognized by the Malaysian Government / University Senate Prerequisites: SPM: Students intending to progress to the Bachelor of Psychology (Hons) upon completion of this program must have obtained credits at SPM/SPMV/O-Level, or grade B in UEC, in Mathematics and a Science subject, and a Pass in English.
